limitations: This is CDP metric evidence, not a screenshot set; no opacity or visibility was forced by the harness.

The pre-change no-JavaScript comparison is the existing matrix captured at 2026-09-16T00:23:13.308Z (baseline 4d851255332733170d3e52a76d96cde654113f27), because the live workflow was unavailable until after the source changes appeared.
The pre-change matrix was recorded against an earlier managed-origin hostname; the post-change run used the current REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN.

IntersectionObserver constructor counters include observers created by other page components as well as BaseLayout; absent/throw checks therefore assert the content fallback and record all attempted constructors, not an isolated BaseLayout count.

Normal-motion running animations include intentional site visualization loops. The reduced-motion check requires zero running animations; normal/no-JS checks require rendered headings to remain visible.
Responsive hidden branches (display:none ancestors) are excluded from heading visibility counts; this avoids treating the desktop audience cards as mobile content failures.

simulatedPersistedRestore.note: Dispatched synthetic pagehide/pageshow events with persisted=true; this is not an actual browser BFCache traversal.
